info.title: API.SH: MusicBrainz
info.description: The MusicBrainz API from API.SH: public MusicBrainz data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A MusicBrainz area (country, subdivision, city, district...) with its ISO 3166-1/2/3 codes, type, life span, aliases in many languages and its relationships (parts of, part of, links).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musicbrainz-area

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MusicBrainz area id (UUID) or musicbrainz.org/area/<id> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: url

get.description:
Entities linked to another, paged: an artist's release groups or releases, a label's releases, a release group's releases, a recording's releases and so on. Give the linked entity as a parameter named after its type (artist=, label=, release=, release-group=, recording=, work=, area=, place=).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musicbrainz-browse

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to list (default release-group).

parameters.name: artist
parameters.description: Artist id.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Label id.

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: Release id.

parameters.name: release_type
parameters.description: Release type filter: album, single, ep, compilation, live, soundtrack ... (several separated by |).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Release status filter: official, promotion, bootleg, pseudo-release.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (1-100, default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The cover art of a release or release group (the album across its editions): every image with its id, types (Front, Back, Booklet, Medium...), front and back flags, approval, comment, full-size link and 250, 500 and 1200 px thumbnails, plus the front and back images and, for a release group, the release the art comes from.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musicbrainz-cover-art

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MusicBrainz release or release group id (the UUID in its musicbrainz.org link); or `url`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What the id is: release (default) or release-group. Taken from `url` when given.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: the musicbrainz.org release or release group link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The MusicBrainz releases that match a CD: by its MusicBrainz disc id, or (fuzzy) by its table of contents. Returns each release with artist, date, country, barcode, labels with catalogue numbers, and the disc's sectors and track offsets.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musicbrainz-discid

parameters.name: discid
parameters.description: MusicBrainz disc id (28 characters).

parameters.name: toc
parameters.description: Table of contents instead of (or with) a disc id: first track, last track, lead-out offset and each track offset, separated by spaces or +.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/musicbrainz-genre

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: page

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Genres per page, up to 100 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
